# Bambu Studio profile data

Copyright Bambu Lab and Bambu Studio contributors.
Upstream: https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/tree/master/resources/profiles
License: GNU Affero General Public License version 3; see LICENSE.

This is an editable flattened P1S 0.4 mm project-settings export. It includes
upstream printer G-code templates. Modified for this display on 2026-09-25:
0.2 mm layers, two walls, 15% infill and normalized filament preset names.
It is separate from the Apache-2.0 model and generator, and copied into the
3MF as Metadata/project_settings.config. It is not relicensed as Apache-2.0.
